title: Reliability of LLM Judges for Evaluating Entity Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.09554v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Entity Alignment (EA) identifies equivalent entities across knowledge graphs and is critical for knowledge base integration and ontology merging. Evaluating EA systems at scale requires expensive expert annotation, making systematic assessment across diverse domains practically infeasible. LLM-as-judge evaluation offers a potentially scalable alternative, yet its reliability for structured prediction tasks like EA remains unstudied. We present the first systematic benchmarking study across three frontier models, three datasets, and four EA systems, using perturbation bias diagnostics, meta-evaluation across all dataset--judge--prompt combinations, and counterfactual label-flip tests. We identify anchor bias, a failure mode in which judges invert discrimination when the system's decision label is visible. translated_title: LLM裁判在实体对齐评估中的可靠性
translated_abstract: 实体对齐（Entity Alignment, EA）用于识别不同知识图谱中的等价实体，对知识库集成和本体合并至关重要。大规模评估EA系统需要昂贵的专家标注，使得跨多样领域的系统性评估在实践中难以实现。LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-judge）的评估方式提供了一种潜在可扩展的替代方案，但其在实体对齐这类结构化预测任务上的可靠性尚未被研究。我们在三个前沿模型、三个数据集和四个EA系统上开展了首个系统性基准测试研究，采用了扰动偏差诊断、覆盖所有数据集-裁判-提示组合的元评估以及反事实标签翻转测试。我们识别出“锚定偏差”（anchor bias）这一失效模式：当系统的决策标签可见时，裁判的判别能力会发生反转。在暴露标签的提示下，裁判的判别能力崩溃（J-ROC-AUC仅为0.12–0.87），而无标签协议则能恢复接近上限的可靠性。
tldr: 本研究首次系统性地基准测试了LLM裁判在实体对齐评估中的可靠性，发现暴露决策标签会引发“锚定偏差”导致判别能力崩溃，并提出无标签评估协议可恢复接近上限的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic benchmarking study of LLM-judge reliability for entity alignment evaluation, identifying "anchor bias" as a failure mode where visible decision labels invert judge discrimination, and demonstrating that a label-free protocol recovers near-ceiling reliability.
